criteria.succeeds: every intake question has the owner's answer or is marked as an open point to confirm
criteria.fails: a value in the draft has no source in the documents or in the owner's answers

criteria.succeeds: the draft is on a branch and its PR cites the library guidance for the skeleton and variant chosen
criteria.fails: the variant choice cites no guidance, or an unknown value is filled in instead of marked to be confirmed

criteria.succeeds: each difference from the parent or back-to-back contract is an open point naming both documents and both values
criteria.fails: a number or term was changed to match the other contract without the owner's decision

criteria.succeeds: the lawyer-review list exists and holds each departure from the library defaults
criteria.fails: a departure from the library defaults is not on the lawyer-review list

criteria.succeeds: each counterparty change is sorted by legal effect with its clause cited, and the revisions are on the branch
criteria.fails: a change of legal effect is accepted on the branch with no decision from the owner

criteria.succeeds: the owner's confirmation of the signing and registering is recorded
criteria.fails: the agent signed, sent or registered the contract itself

criteria.succeeds: a library proposal names its source contracts and its reason, or the record says there is none
criteria.fails: a clause entered the library without the owner's acceptance
